Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I had an issue with my order and it…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69f926bc4483e9fd7a8d8f92)
I had an issue with my order and it took soooooo long to resolve it... I couldn't get a customer service rep on the phone... which, as a decorator, is frustrating. I was trying to resolve an issue for a client and there was a deadline... and I couldn't get anyone on your team to respond. What few response responses my assistant received felt AI generated as they didn't really address the questions that were being asked. If I hadn't already shown my client your product and had approval, I would have pivoted immediately. Needless to say, I will shop elsewhere in the future... at businesses that value decorators who shop over and over and over again... kind regards, Eric Hughes

April 29, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 5, 2026

Hi Eric,

Thank you for your feedback. We understand how frustrating it can be when communication is not timely, especially when working with client deadlines. Our Trade Support team is ready to assist you further; they can follow up with a scheduled phone call if you'd prefer that over email. Please let us know if you have any other questions in the meantime, and we appreciate your understanding.

Lulu and Georgia
